item.title: 🇷🇺 #ELECTIONS2026 On September 20, voting concluded in the elections to the 9th convocation of the State Duma of the Russian Federation
item.description: #ELECTIONS2026 🇷🇺 On September 20, voting concluded in the elections to the 9th convocation of the State Duma of the Russian Federation . The last polling station at a Russian diplomatic mission abroad closed today at 5:00 am Moscow time . Through the efforts of Russia’s Central Election Commission and Foreign Ministry , all necessary arrangements were made to enable Russian citizens residing or temporarily staying abroad to exercise their right to vote – from the far reaches of the Arctic to the most remote corners of the globe . 🌐 A total of 326 polling stations were set up at Russian diplomatic missions – embassies, permanent missions and consulates general – in 152 countries . In seven countries ( Bahrain , Israel , Iraq , Yemen , China , Kuwait and Libya ), all voting took place ahead of the main election day to accommodate local work schedules and religious calendars. Russian diplomatic and consular missions organised 121 early voting sessions for employees of Russian companies and enterprises working far from home , as well as Russian military personnel safeguarding the security and sovereignty of our allies. In unfriendly countries, where the local authorities encouraged persistent attempts to intimidate Russian citizens ahead of the election campaign, our compatriots stood firm and voted responsibly despite the psychological pressure exerted on them. *** 👉 As per tradition, we have compiled a comprehensive roundup of posts on voting abroad: 🗳 Early voting at off-site

item.title: ⚔️ September 21 – victory at the Battle of Kulikovo – Russia’s Day of Military Glory.
item.description: ⚔️ September 21 – victory at the Battle of Kulikovo – Russia’s Day of Military Glory. #OTD in 1380, Russian regiments led by Grand Prince Dmitry (Rurikovich) of Moscow defeated the forces of Mamai – a powerful warlord of the Golden Horde. In the late 14th century, Mamai’s campaign sought to restore his authority over the Russian lands and enforce tribute payments . Answering Moscow’s call, warriors from different principalities gathered under Dmitry’s command to confront the advancing army. ⚔️ The armies clashed on Kulikovo Field, near the Don and Nepryadva rivers, in what is now Russia’s Tula Region . By crossing the Don, Dmitry committed his forces to battle before Mamai could join up with his allies. The spiritual memory of the campaign is closely associated with St Sergius of Radonezh , who, according to legend, blessed Dmitry before he set out. One of the best-known episodes of the battle is the legendary duel between a Russian warrior monk Peresvet and the Horde’s champion Chelubey . Both received fatal wounds, yet Peresvet remained in the saddle. Grand Prince Dmitry himself fought among his men , without the outward distinction of his rank, and survived the fierce fighting. *** 🐎 The decisive blow came from the ambush regiment , commanded by Prince Vladimir of Serpukhov and Dmitry Bobrok-Volynsky . Held back in an oak grove, these cavalry troops struck at a critical moment, turning the tide against Mamai’s forces, sending them fleeing from the battlefield. The victory

⚔️
September 21 –
victory at the Battle of Kulikovo
– Russia’s Day of Military Glory.
#OTD
in 1380, Russian regiments led by Grand Prince
Dmitry
(Rurikovich)
of Moscow
defeated the forces of
Mamai
– a powerful warlord of the Golden Horde.
In the late 14th century,
Mamai’s campaign sought to restore his authority over the Russian lands and enforce tribute payments
. Answering Moscow’s call, warriors from different principalities gathered under Dmitry’s command to confront the advancing army.
⚔️
The armies clashed on Kulikovo Field,
near the Don and Nepryadva rivers, in what is now
Russia’s Tula Region
. By crossing the Don, Dmitry committed his forces to battle before Mamai could join up with his allies.
The spiritual memory of the campaign is closely associated with
St Sergius of Radonezh
, who, according to legend, blessed Dmitry before he set out.
One of the best-known episodes of the battle is the legendary duel between a Russian warrior monk
Peresvet
and the Horde’s champion
Chelubey
. Both received fatal wounds, yet Peresvet remained in the saddle.
Grand Prince Dmitry himself fought among his men
, without the outward distinction of his rank, and survived the fierce fighting.
***
🐎
The decisive blow came from the ambush regiment
, commanded by Prince
Vladimir of Serpukhov
and
Dmitry Bobrok-Volynsky
. Held back in an oak grove, these cavalry troops struck at a critical moment, turning the tide against Mamai’s forces, sending them fleeing from the battlefield.
The victory earned Dmitry the name Donskoy – “of the Don”.
The struggle to throw off the Horde’s yoke
continued for another century
, until
the Great Stand on the Ugra River in 1480
.
✊
The Battle of Kulikovo holds an enduring place in Russian history as a symbol of unity, courage and determination to defend the Fatherland
– a victory that strengthened confidence in the eventual liberation of the Russian lands.
***
In August 2026, the relics of Grand Prince Dmitry Donskoy
were uncovered
at
the Archangel Cathedral of the Moscow Kremlin
.
He was canonized by
the Russian Orthodox Church in 1988 as a Holy Right-Believing Grand Prince in recognition of his outstanding service to the Church and the people, as well as his deeply devout life, which embodied the Christian ideal of self-sacrifice for the good and salvation of others.

item.title: ✒️ Comment by Ambassador Albert P. Khorev to TASS News Agency Following the Voting held at the Embassy
item.description: ✒️ Comment by Ambassador Albert P. Khorev to TASS News Agency Following the Voting held at the Embassy (September 20, 2026): 💬 Voting at the polling station at the Embassy of Russia in Pakistan has successfully concluded. A total of 130 people cast their ballots, including the leadership and staff of the Embassy and Trade Mission, their family members, as well as Russian citizens residing in or temporarily staying in Pakistan. Observers from the Civic Chamber of Russia present at the polling station noted that voting was conducted in full compliance with the established procedures, with no violations identified. ❗️ It should be noted that the voting took place amid a challenging social situation, with heightened protest activity and partial traffic restrictions in Islamabad. Nevertheless, the Embassy, in close coordination with the Pakistani authorities, took additional measures to inform Russian citizens and arranged convenient transportation to the polling station. All necessary conditions were created to enable Russian citizens residing in Islamabad and the surrounding areas to cast their ballots. 🤝 I would like to personally thank all Russian citizens who exercised their right to vote in the elections of deputies to the State Duma of the Federal Assembly of the Russian Federation of the ninth convocation, demonstrating a strong sense of civic responsibility. #Elections2026

item.title: ⚡️ #RussiaHelps Russia's EMERCOM On September 19, Russia’s EMERCOM Il-76 aircraft returned to Moscow from Serbia
item.description: #RussiaHelps ⚡️ Russia's EMERCOM : 🛬 On September 19, Russia’s EMERCOM Il-76 aircraft returned to Moscow from Serbia . The aircraft helped combat wildfires in Serbia on the instructions of President of Russia Vladimir Putin . The EMERCOM Il-76 crew carried out 65 flights , dropping 2,730 tonnes of water on the fires. The aircraft is equipped with a VAP-2 water discharge system capable of releasing 42 tonnes of water in a single drop, which proved crucial in tackling major blazes. Russian emergency responders worked in the most challenging areas. In the Deliblato Sands Special Nature Reserve , the fires spread across more than 3,500 hectares , while difficult terrain and water shortages hampered ground crews. Operating conditions were near-extreme : temperatures above 40°C , heavy smoke, mountainous terrain and limited visibility. The aircraft also fought fires on the steep slopes of Suva Planina, in the Stolovi area near Kraljevo, and in Lukovo near Vranje. The Il-76 worked alongside two Ka-32 helicopters and Serbian firefighting crews on the ground . The EMERCOM crew helped extinguish the main fires and prevent the flames from reaching nearby communities. *** 🤝 Russian emergency responders have a long history of helping the Serbian people. • In 1999 , during NATO’s bombing of Yugoslavia , Russia’s EMERCOM deployed an air-mobile hospital to Serbia and delivered medicines, equipment and humanitarian supplies. • From 2008 to 2016 , EMERCOM bomb disposal specialists cleared mine

item.title: 🇷🇺 Voting in elections to Russia’s 9th State Duma has already ended at the majority of Russian diplomatic missions abroad.
item.description: 🇷🇺 Voting in elections to Russia’s 9th State Duma has already ended at the majority of Russian diplomatic missions abroad. But for our diplomats, the working day is far from over. The last polling station is set to close at 5:00 am Moscow time on September 21. ☝️ Closing the doors was only the beginning of the most important stage. Our colleagues must complete the formal procedures, sort the ballots, reconcile the figures against the number of ballots issued, and count the votes by hand. Then come the checks, the double-checks – and another check to make sure everything adds up. Once the count is complete, the results must be recorded and submitted to Russia’s Central Election Commission for approval. Every vote counts , and behind every ballot cast abroad is the prudent work of our colleagues. 📸 Here’s how voting unfolded at some of our embassies and consulates general: • Albania • Algeria • Angola • Argentina • Armenia • Austria • Azerbaijan • Belarus • Belgium • Bolivia • Botswana • Britain • Burundi • Canada • Cameroon • CAR • Chile • Colombia • Croatia • Cuba • Czechia • Denmark • Ecuador • Ethiopia • Estonia • Finland • France • Greece • Guinea • India • Indonesia • Ireland • Italy • Jamaica • Lithuania • Mauritania • Mauritius • Montenegro • Mozambique • Namibia • Netherlands • Niger • Norway • Panama • Poland • Portugal • Republic of Korea • Serbia • Seychelles • Slovenia • South Africa • Spain • Sweden • Switzerland • Turkiye • Turkmenistan • Tunisia • UAE • Uganda •
